420:     _require(token.semantic.choice == custody.selected.choice
421:              and token.semantic.revision == custody.selected.revision
422:              and token.semantic.manifest == custody.release.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
423:              "Durable selection differs from approved startup")
424:     if session is None:
425:         _require(record.owner is None and custody.consumed_by is None,
426:                  "Unconsumed pre-worker startup required")
427:     else:
428:         _require(type(session) is OwnedSession and record.owner is session
429:                  and session._record is record and session._manager is manager
430:                  and session._worker is None and not session._revoked and not session._closing
431:                  and session._active == 0 and not session._closed_verified,
432:                  "Exact live pre-worker session required")
433: 
434: 
435: def _validate_controller_startup(startup, permit, session=None):
436:     _require(type(startup) is _ControllerASRStart, "Issued controller startup required")
437:     custody = _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup))
438:     _require(type(custody) is _StartupCustody and custody.startup is startup,
439:              "Copied controller startup has no issuance authority")
440:     with custody.manager._lock:
441:         with custody.token._lock:
442:             _validate_startup_locked(custody, startup, permit, session)
443:     return startup
444: 
445: 
446: def _consume_controller_startup(startup, permit, session):
447:     # Fixed future worker infrastructure may take this controller record once.
448:     # It is not an IPC witness, child-local lease or permission to construct.
449:     _require(type(startup) is _ControllerASRStart, "Issued controller startup required")
450:     custody = _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup))
451:     _require(type(custody) is _StartupCustody and custody.startup is startup,
452:              "Copied controller startup has no issuance authority")
453:     with custody.manager._lock:
454:         with custody.token._lock:
455:             _validate_startup_locked(custody, startup, permit, session)
456:             _require(custody.consumed_by is None, "Controller startup was already consumed")
457:             custody.consumed_by = session
458:     return startup

461: def _fixed_real_worker_start(startup, permit, session):
462:     _validate_controller_startup(startup, permit, session)
463:     raise AdapterUnavailable("Authenticated child transport, runtime state and fixed real bootstrap are unavailable")

466: @contextmanager
467: def _controller_startup_scope(choice, caller_root, *, usage, root_kind):
468:     """Retain accepted controller input before the still-closed worker seam.
469: 
470:     No acquisition, worker start or model constructor is called here. Once a
471:     native permit is reserved, an unfinished scope remains quarantined under
472:     the existing exception-aware lifecycle; it never invents no-worker cleanup.
473:     """
474:     configured = _startup_configuration()
475:     authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot = _STARTUP_RELEASE(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind)
476:     _require(authority is configured, "Startup release changed during selection")
477:     profile = _STARTUP_PROFILE(authority, usage)
478:     manager, factory = SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE, RUNTIME_FACTORY
479:     _require(type(manager) is DurableSnapshotLifecycle and type(factory) is DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory
480:              and factory.manager is manager, "Exact durable startup lifecycle and factory required")
481:     custody = _StartupCustody(authority, trusted, selected, profile, usage, manager, factory)
482:     # Custody starts before any lease/admission/binding operation can fail.
483:     _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS[id(custody)] = custody
484:     try:
485:         # Retain the lease wrapper before entry can reserve protection.
486:         custody.lease = manager.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision)
487:         _require(type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease and custody.lease.manager is manager,
488:                  "Exact issued durable lease required")
489:         with custody.lease:
490:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
491:             custody.admission = _STARTUP_ADMIT(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)
492:             admitted = custody.admission
493:             _require(type(admitted) is resolver.Admission and type(admitted.manifest) is resolver.TrustedManifest
494:                      and admitted.manifest == trusted and admitted.manifest.approval is authority.manifest_approval
495:                      and admitted.choice == choice and admitted.snapshot == str(snapshot)
496:                      and admitted.private_root == str(store), "Exact successful selected admission required")
497:             # Admission reparses the manifest; retain its exact selected object,
498:             # while retaining the initial approved manifest separately.
499:             custody.selected = next(model for model in admitted.manifest.models if model.choice == choice)
500:             _require(custody.selected == selected, "Admission selected a different model")
501:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
502:             custody.permit = custody.lease.begin_native_session()
503:             custody.record = custody.permit.record
504:             custody.key = custody.record.key
505:             custody.protection = custody.record.protection
506:             custody.token = custody.lease.token
507:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
508:             custody.binding = _STARTUP_BIND(admitted)
509:             b = custody.binding
510:             _require(type(b) is resolver.LocalBinding and b.choice == choice
511:                      and b.revision == custody.selected.revision
512:                      and b.manifest_sha256 == authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256
513:                      and b.model_path == admitted.snapshot and b.files == admitted.files
514:                      and b.local_files_only is True and b.constructor_called is False
515:                      and b.real_runtime_approved is False, "Exact rechecked local startup binding required")
516:             startup = _ControllerASRStart(authority, authority.manifest_approval, trusted,
517:                 admitted, custody.selected, profile, usage, b, custody.permit)
518:             custody.startup = startup
519:             custody.references, custody.values = _startup_references(custody), _startup_values(custody)
520:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS[id(startup)] = custody
521:             _validate_controller_startup(startup, custody.permit)
522:             try:
523:                 yield startup
524:             finally:
525:                 with manager._lock:
526:                     custody.active = False
527:     except BaseException as original:
528:         custody.primary_error = original
529:         raise
530:     finally:
531:         custody.active = False
532:         # A failed/reserved attempt remains retained. It is never converted to
533:         # completion by removing Python references or by a recorded digest.
534:         record = custody.lease.inner._record if type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease else None
535:         if record is not None and record.phase is Phase.RELEASED:
536:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.pop(id(custody), None)
537:             if custody.startup is not None:
538:                 _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.pop(id(custody.startup), None)
